title: NTP2 topological structures
summary: A subset of a topological space is constructible if it is a finite Boolean combination of closed sets. We prove that every NTP$_2$ expansion of $(\mathbb{R},<,+)$ by constructible sets defines only constructible sets, and that definable functions are generically piecewise continuous. The result also holds for all NTP$_2$ expansions of $(\mathbb{Q}_p,+,\cdot)$, and all NTP$_2$ definably complete expansions of ordered groups.
